profileEvidence.author: C
profileEvidence.summary: Sinhala Hounds can be playful and closely attached to their people, enjoying games and learning quickly. Energy varies: some relish active outings, while others enjoy lounging beside a companion. Ocean, a grown rescue dog, was energetic and initially tense with unfamiliar people, then affectionate once he knew them.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Sinhala Hounds can be playful, quick to learn and closely bonded; energy and initial reserve vary between individuals.
